name: DeLorean DMC-12 V8
description:
The DeLorean DMC-12 is one of the most iconic automobiles ever created, immortalized by the Back to the Future film trilogy. Originally launched in 1981, John DeLorean's ambitious sports car featured distinctive gull-wing doors, a stainless steel body, and rear-engine layout. However, the original 2.8-liter PRV (Peugeot-Renault-Volvo) V6 engine produced only 130 horsepower, leaving the futuristic DMC-12 chronically underpowered and unable to live up to its exotic appearance.

This V8-swapped variant addresses the DeLorean's greatest weakness by replacing the anemic PRV V6 with a modern Chevrolet LS-series V8 engine. The LS swap has become the most popular engine conversion for the DeLorean, and for good reason: the compact, lightweight LS engine fits remarkably well in the DeLorean's engine bay while delivering massive performance gains. This particular example features a 5.7-liter LS1 V8 producing 498 horsepower and 674 Nm of torque—nearly four times the power of the original engine.

The transformation is dramatic. What was once a stylish but sluggish GT car becomes a genuine high-performance sports car capable of matching its stunning looks with equally impressive acceleration and top speed. The LS engine's compact dimensions, proven reliability, and massive aftermarket support make it the ideal powerplant to finally give the DeLorean the performance it always deserved. This is the DeLorean as it should have been from the factory.
author: S3R1U5 & VincentGC
